newsitem.title: PERU: Peru tax revenues fall 0.8 pct in Oct vs yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Peru tax revenues fall 0.8 pct in Oct vs yr ago.

text.p: Peru's tax revenues fell in October to 1.611 billion soles, 0.8 percent lower in inflation-adjusted terms than the same month last year, the National Superintendency of Tax Administration (SUNAT) said Monday.
The SUNAT added accumulated revenues for the first ten months of 1996 were 16.476 billion soles, up 6.2 percent compared with the same period last year after taking into account inflation.
Tax collection last year rose 27.7 percent nominally to 17.063 billion soles, from 13.363 billion soles in 1994.
Peru's cumulative consumer inflation in the first ten months of 1996 was 9.99 percent, up from 8.3 percent in the same period last year.
